note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz; quotations are spliced verbatim from it (founder decision 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere). A partial verse quotes the shortest contiguous OWB span that carries the clause; the FAQ answer's Romans 13 quotation matches the body's.
Matthew 13:24-30 is an allusion (the Church as a mixed field of wheat and weeds) in the biographer's own voice, not a quotation, and stays prose.
